commands: grep -i 'memory size.*exhausted\|Allowed memory' /var/log/php-fpm/www-error.log 2>/dev/null | tail -30 || grep -i 'memory size.*exhausted\|Allowed memory' /var/log/httpd/moodle_error.log 2>/dev/null | tail -30 || echo 'no oom in standard logs'
echo '=== Full stack trace around redis OOM ==='

grep -A 20 'redis/lib.php on line 431' /var/log/php-fpm/www-error.log 2>/dev/null | tail -60 || grep -A 20 'redis/lib.php on line 431' /var/log/httpd/moodle_error.log 2>/dev/null | tail -60 || echo 'not found'
redis-cli -h moo-mo-isf4hcml1bjy.cgt4zg.0001.cac1.cache.amazonaws.com info memory 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'used_memory_human|maxmemory_human|mem_fragmentation' || echo 'redis-cli not available'

redis-cli -h moo-mo-isf4hcml1bjy.cgt4zg.0001.cac1.cache.amazonaws.com --scan --pattern 'MoodleCache/*' 2>/dev/null | head -5 | while read k; do size=$(redis-cli -h moo-mo-isf4hcml1bjy.cgt4zg.0001.cac1.cache.amazonaws.com strlen "$k" 2>/dev/null); echo "$size $k"; done | sort -rn | head -10 || echo 'scan skipped'
